From: Lawrence Paulson <lp15@cam.ac.uk>

I’m happy to announce that we have a formal version of a very recent result: The Irrationality of ζ(5)

by Alex Raymond Hyman October.

I abbreviate the lengthy abstract:

We formalise the proof that is irrational from A. Fauzan's 2026 preprint (Zenodo, doi:10.5281/zenodo.22826419), following the Lean 4/Mathlib formalisation of the same argument by domino14 (github.com/domino14/zeta5), of which this entry is a port. ... the whole development lives in HOL without Types-To-Sets; Lean's kernel computation on 1052 dyadic intervals becomes approximation with splitting.
Thirteen theories are independent of the proof and reusable.

https://isa-afp.org/entries/Zeta_5_Irrational.html
